blurb.en: Twelve-channel mixer, twelve-track SD recorder and USB interface, with five separate headphone mixes.
blurb.fi: Kaksitoistakanavainen mikseri, kaksitoistaraitainen SD-tallennin ja USB-liitäntä, viisi erillistä kuulokemiksausta.
blurb.sv: Tolvkanalsmixer, tolvspårs SD-inspelare och USB-interface, med fem separata hörlursmixar.

pull.q: It should make an absolutely brilliant tool for bands, serving as a live-sound mixer for small gigs, a multitrack recorder in the rehearsal room and a USB audio interface in the studio.

quotes.t: Zoom reimagine the stand-alone multitracker for the DAW generation.
One is that, speaking for myself, I'd have found solo buttons infinitely more useful than the mute buttons provided.
quotes.s: Sound On Sound · the honest caveat
